sloka: दिष्ट्या ऽसि मे राघव दृष्टिमार्गं प्राप्तो ऽन्तगामी विपरीतबुद्धिः ।अस्मिन् क्षणे यास्यसि मृत्युदेशं संसाद्यमानो मम बाणजालैः ।। ६.५९.९६ ।।।।
transliteration: diṣṭyā 'si me rāghava dṛṣṭimārgaṁ prāpto 'ntagāmī viparītabuddhiḥ ।asmin kṣaṇe yāsyasi mṛtyudeśaṁ saṁsādyamāno mama bāṇajālaiḥ ।। 6.59.96 ।।।।

translations.english: Hearing the challenging statement of the king of Rakshasas and hearing the vibrating sound, Saumithri standing close by spoke these wrathful words.
